audit.note: toggle is wired roundtrip-free via _event_client( control_global, MESSAGE_TOAST.show )

deviations.what: SidePanel.toggle shows a client-side MessageToast on every toggle. The original onToggle inspected the preventExpand/preventCollapse switches and called event.preventDefault() to veto the expand/collapse (toasting only when a veto fired, then resetting the switch); an event veto is not expressible in abap2UI5, so that behaviour is lost and the switches are kept as static controls.
